items.title: General Mills Soars 5% With Packaged Food as Kraft Heinz Calls 2027 Price Hikes “Likely”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysGeneral Mills shares rose 5% today with Campbell’s, Conagra and Smucker after Kraft Heinz said price increases are likely in 2027. Investors are betting packaged-food makers can pass rising costs on to shoppers.

items.title: General Mills (GIS) Brings Limited Time Latte Cereals To Breakfast Aisles
items.summary: General Mills (NYSE:GIS) announced a first-time collaboration with Dunkin' to launch limited-time latte-inspired breakfast cereals. The new cereals pair General Mills' existing cereal brands with flavors based on popular Dunkin' lattes. The products are being positioned as exclusive offerings in the crowded ready-to-eat cereal aisle. items.title: Ingredion Readies for Q3 Earnings: What's in the Cards for the Stock?
items.summary: Ingredion's Q3 earnings are likely to have faced pressure from its Pakistan divestiture, currency headwinds and higher costs, while specialty ingredient demand may have offered some support.
